name: @utaba/deep-memory-local-mcp-server

tools.name: memory_create_repository
tools.description: Create a new memory repository with an optional vocabulary definition and governance mode

legal.description: Legal or compliance notes for this repository

owner.description: Owner of the repository (person, team, or org)

defaultSimilarityThreshold.description: Default similarity threshold for semantic search (0.0-1.0, default: 0.5). Lower for local embedding models, higher for OpenAI.

metadata.description: Extensible metadata object. Embedding model info (embeddingModelId, embeddingDimensions) is auto-detected from the configured provider if omitted.

vocabulary.description: Initial vocabulary with entityTypes and relationshipTypes arrays

tools.name: memory_open_repository
tools.description: Open a memory repository by ID or label. Call this first before any entity, relationship, or graph operations. Returns vocabulary and stats.

repositoryId.description: ID of the repository to open

label.description: Repository label — use as alternative to repositoryId

tools.name: memory_list_repositories
tools.description: List all available memory repositories

tools.name: memory_get_repository
tools.description: Get the full stored record for a single repository — including legal, owner, metadata (embeddingModelId, embeddingDimensions), governance config, and creation provenance. Resolve by ID or label.

label.description: Repository label — use as alternative to repositoryId

tools.name: memory_update_repository
tools.description: Update repository metadata and settings — label, description, governance mode, similarity threshold, etc.

legal.description: Legal terms, licence, or compliance notes

defaultSimilarityThreshold.description: Default similarity threshold for semantic search (0.0-1.0). Model-dependent — lower for local models, higher for OpenAI.

requireApproval.description: Managed mode: if true, all vocabulary proposals queue for human approval

deduplicationEnabled.description: Open mode: whether vocabulary deduplication is enforced (default true)

autoApproveThreshold.description: Managed mode: similarity score below which vocabulary proposals auto-approve (default 0.3)

tools.name: memory_delete_repository
tools.description: Delete a memory repository and all its data permanently. Use deleteContentsOnly to remove all entities and relationships while keeping the repository and vocabulary intact.

repositoryId.description: ID of the repository to delete

deleteContentsOnly.description: When true, only delete entities and relationships — the repository and vocabulary are preserved. Defaults to false.

tools.name: memory_ensure_schema
tools.description: Ensure the storage provider schema exists (creates tables/indexes if needed). Idempotent — safe to call multiple times. Only relevant for persistent storage providers (e.g., SQL Server); no-op for in-memory storage.

tools.name: memory_validate_entities
tools.description: Audit entities in the repository against the current vocabulary. Paging is issue-based: `take` caps how many issues are returned, `offset` skips that many issues. Typical workflow: call with offset=0, fix the returned issues, call again with offset=0. `offset` is only for inspecting a later slice without mutating. Loop until `done` is true. Returns issues fixable with memory_update_entity. Use memory_validate_relationships for relationships.

offset.description: Number of issues to skip before returning (default 0). The normal fix-and-retry workflow always uses 0; pass nextOffset only to inspect a later slice without fixing.

take.description: Maximum issues to return in this call (default 200)

delayBetweenChunksMs.description: Pause between export chunks for manual rate limiting (default 0)

tools.name: memory_validate_relationships
tools.description: Audit relationships in the repository against the current vocabulary. Paging is issue-based: `take` caps how many issues are returned, `offset` skips that many issues. Typical workflow: call with offset=0, fix the returned issues, call again with offset=0. `offset` is only for inspecting a later slice without mutating. Loop until `done` is true. The full entity set is loaded once per call to resolve orphan and type-mismatch checks. Returns issues fixable with memory_remove_relationships / memory_create_relationships.

offset.description: Number of issues to skip before returning (default 0). The normal fix-and-retry workflow always uses 0; pass nextOffset only to inspect a later slice without fixing.

take.description: Maximum issues to return in this call (default 200)

delayBetweenChunksMs.description: Pause between export chunks for manual rate limiting (default 0)

tools.name: memory_create_entities
tools.description: Create one or more entities (nodes) in a repository. Entity types and properties must match the repository vocabulary — call memory_open_repository first to see valid types. Property names must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and must not be reserved system fields (label, slug, createdAt, ...). Every entity is validated before any is written: if one fails validation, nothing is created. If storing fails part-way, the error response lists code BATCH_PARTIAL_FAILURE, failedIndex and the entities already stored in "created"; resend only the entities not in "created", because resending a stored entity creates a duplicate.

repositoryId.description: Repository to create the entities in

dataFormat.description: Format of the data field (e.g. text/plain, text/markdown)

tools.name: memory_update_entity
tools.description: Update an existing entity — entityType, label, summary, properties, or data. Accepts entity ID (GUID) or slug. Changing entityType must be valid in the vocabulary and regenerates the slug with the new type prefix. To clear an optional field, pass null: summary/data/dataFormat set to null are cleared, and property values set to null are removed from the entity (RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch). Omitting a field leaves it unchanged.

entityType.description: New entity type — must exist in the vocabulary. Regenerates the slug and re-validates properties against the new type.

summary.description: New summary. Pass null to clear the existing summary.

properties.description: Properties to merge with existing. Property values set to null are removed from the entity (RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch semantics).

data.description: New raw content/data. Pass null to clear.

dataFormat.description: Format of the data field. Pass null to clear.

reembed.description: Force regeneration of the embedding vector (e.g. after switching embedding models)

tools.name: memory_get_entity
tools.description: Retrieve a single entity by ID (GUID) or slug with configurable detail level (brief, summary, or full)

tools.name: memory_find_entities
tools.description: Search for entities by label, type, or properties with pagination. Requires a repository to be opened first via memory_open_repository.

searchTerm.description: Search term to match against entity labels

entityType.description: Filter by a single entity type (convenience alias for entityTypes)

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

conversationId.description: Filter to entities from this conversation

actor.description: Filter to entities created/modified by this actor

includeRelationshipSummary.description: Attach a relationship count summary (out/in by type) to each entity (default false)

tools.name: memory_delete_entities
tools.description: Delete one or more entities and their associated relationships from the knowledge graph in a single batch operation. Accepts entity IDs (GUIDs) or slugs.

entityIds.description: Entity IDs (GUIDs or slugs) to delete

tools.name: memory_reembed_repository
tools.description: Re-embed all entities in a repository. Optionally switch to a different embedding model or dimensionality — the repository metadata is updated first so subsequent writes use the new configuration. Retries failed batches with exponential backoff. Aborts early if error threshold is reached.

model.description: New embedding model identifier to switch the repository to (e.g. "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B"). Omit to keep the current model.

dimensions.description: New embedding dimensionality to switch the repository to (e.g. 1024). Omit to keep the current dimensionality.

maxRetries.description: Retries per batch on embedding API failure with exponential backoff (default 3)

errorThresholdToAbort.description: Abort after this many cumulative failures. Omit for no limit.

delayBetweenBatchesMs.description: Milliseconds to wait between batches for rate limiting (default 0)

tools.name: memory_create_relationships
tools.description: Create one or more relationships (edges) between entities. Relationship types must be in the vocabulary. Entity references accept either GUID or slug. Property names must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and must not be reserved system fields. Every relationship (including its endpoints) is validated before any is written: if one fails validation, nothing is created. If storing fails part-way, the error response lists code BATCH_PARTIAL_FAILURE, failedIndex and the relationships already stored in "created"; resend only the relationships not in "created", because resending a stored relationship creates a duplicate.

tools.name: memory_remove_relationships
tools.description: Remove one or more relationships (edges) from the knowledge graph in a single batch operation

tools.name: memory_get_relationships
tools.description: Get all relationships for a given entity, with optional type and direction filters. Accepts entity ID (GUID) or slug.

direction.description: Direction filter relative to the queried entity (default: both)

tools.name: memory_explore_neighborhood
tools.description: Explore the neighborhood of an entity using BFS traversal (depth 1-3). Accepts entity ID (GUID) or slug. Relationship type names and filter keys must be identifiers matching ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (e.g. WORKS_AT, start_date); any other name, or a depth outside 1-3, is rejected with a validation error.

relationshipTypes.description: Filter by relationship type(s); each must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$

direction.description: Direction filter relative to the queried entity (default: both)

limitPerType.description: Max entities per relationship type (default 10, max 50)

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

relationshipPropertyFilters.description: Filter relationships by property values (AND); each key must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$

tools.name: memory_find_paths
tools.description: Find paths between two entities in the knowledge graph. Accepts entity IDs (GUID) or slugs. Bounds: maxDepth 1-5, limit 1-200, offset 0-1000, all integers. Relationship type names and filter keys must be identifiers matching ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (e.g. WORKS_AT, start_date). Out-of-range values and other names are rejected with a validation error.

relationshipTypes.description: Filter allowed relationship types; each must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$

entityTypes.description: Filter entities in paths by type(s)

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return (default: 5, max: 200)

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: brief)

relationshipPropertyFilters.description: Filter relationships by property values (AND); each key must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$

tools.name: memory_get_graph
tools.description: Get the knowledge graph for a repository — entities, relationships, vocabulary, and stats. Returns up to 200 entities per page with a cursor for continuation. For large repositories, prefer memory_query_graph, memory_find_entities with filters and memory_explore_neighborhood for targeted exploration.

repositoryId.description: Repository to get the graph for

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

tools.name: memory_query_graph
tools.description:
Query the knowledge graph — vertex lookups, property projection, and multi-hop traversals in a single tool.

## Projection (property extraction and aggregation)

Use `projection` to extract property values from entities. When projection is present, only the aggregated values are returned (no entity objects) — this keeps responses lightweight. Set `projection.includeEntities: true` if you also need the full entity objects.

- Distinct values: `{ start: { entityType: "Equipment" }, projection: { properties: ["equipmentType"], distinct: true }, limit: 200 }`
- Count by value: `{ start: { entityType: "Equipment" }, projection: { properties: ["equipmentType"], mode: "count" }, limit: 200 }`
- Multi-property: `{ start: { entityType: "Equipment" }, projection: { properties: ["equipmentType", "tier"], distinct: true }, limit: 200 }`

## Vertex queries (no steps, no projection)

Query entities directly by type and properties — returns entity objects:
- By type: `{ start: { entityType: "Fluid" }, limit: 50 }`
- With filter: `{ start: { entityType: "Fluid", filter: [{ key: "fluidType", operator: "eq", value: "hydraulic-oil" }] }, limit: 50 }`

## Traversals (with steps)

Follow relationships through the graph:
- 2-hop: `{ start: { entityId: "Equipment:komatsu-pc7000-11" }, steps: [{ direction: "out", relationshipTypes: ["HAS_COMPONENT"] }, { direction: "out", relationshipTypes: ["REQUIRES_FLUID"] }] }`
- Filtered edges: `{ start: { entityId: "Equipment:komatsu-pc7000-11" }, steps: [{ direction: "both", relationshipTypes: ["COMPATIBLE_WITH"], relationshipFilter: [{ key: "passCount", operator: "gte", value: 3 }] }] }`
- Variable depth: `{ start: { entityId: "..." }, steps: [{ direction: "out", relationshipTypes: ["CONTAINS"], repeat: { maxDepth: 5 } }] }`

Projection works with traversals too — add `projection` to aggregate properties from the traversal results.

## Names and bounds

- Relationship type names, filter keys (`start.filter`, `relationshipFilter`, `entityFilter`, `repeat.until`) and `projection.properties` must be identifiers matching `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` (e.g. `HAS_COMPONENT`, `fluid_type`).
- Projection reads user properties only: a reserved or system field name (`id`, `label`, `slug`, `entityType`, `summary`, `createdAt`, …) is refused.
- `limit` 1-200 and `offset` 0-1000, integers. `repeat.maxDepth` is a positive integer, and the steps' total depth must stay within the provider's maximum.
- A name or value outside these rules is rejected with a validation error before the query runs.

The response's `queryMetadata` carries `executionTimeMs`, `appliedLimits`, `truncated` and, when truncated, `truncationReason`.

start.description: Which entities to query or start traversing from

entityId.description: Specific entity by ID (GUID) or slug

entityType.description: All entities of a given type (requires limit)

steps.description: Relationship hops to follow. Omit for vertex-only queries.

direction.description: Direction to traverse, relative to the entity at the start of the hop

relationshipTypes.description: Relationship types to follow (omit for all); each must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$

entityFilter.description: Filter target entities by property values

repeat.description: Repeat this step for variable-depth traversal

maxDepth.description: Maximum iterations (required; a positive integer, within the provider maximum together with the other steps)

until.description: Stop when entity matches these filters

projection.description: Property projection — extract and aggregate property values from result entities. When present, only aggregations are returned (no entity objects). Set includeEntities: true to also get entity objects.

properties.description: User property names to extract from entities; each must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and must not be a reserved or system field name

distinct.description: Return only distinct value combinations (default: false)

mode.description: values (default): raw property values. count: count entities per distinct combination

includeEntities.description: Also return full entity objects alongside projections (default: false)

includeRelationshipSummary.description: Attach out/in relationship counts by type to each entity (default: true). Set false to reduce response size.

tools.name: memory_search_by_concept
tools.description: Semantic search for entities by concept similarity (requires an EmbeddingProvider)

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

tools.name: memory_get_vocabulary
tools.description: Get the vocabulary definition for a repository — shows available entity types, relationship types, and governance mode

includeProvenance.description: Include createdAt/createdBy/modifiedAt/modifiedBy on type definitions (default: false)

tools.name: memory_propose_vocabulary_extension
tools.description: Propose a new entity type or relationship type. Only needed when the vocabulary doesn't already include the type you need — check memory_open_repository response first. An error saying the vocabulary was changed concurrently (VOCABULARY_VERSION_CONFLICT) means it changed underneath this proposal three times in a row; re-read the vocabulary and resubmit.

entityType.description: Entity type definition (when proposalType is entity_type)

relationshipType.description: Relationship type definition (when proposalType is relationship_type)

editEntityType.description: Edit an existing entity type (when proposalType is edit_entity_type)

type.description: Name of the entity type to edit

editRelationshipType.description: Edit an existing relationship type (when proposalType is edit_relationship_type)

type.description: Name of the relationship type to edit

deleteEntityType.description: Delete an entity type and all its instances (when proposalType is delete_entity_type)

type.description: Name of the entity type to delete

deleteRelationshipType.description: Delete a relationship type and all its instances (when proposalType is delete_relationship_type)

type.description: Name of the relationship type to delete

justification.description: Why this vocabulary change is needed

tools.name: memory_get_stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a repository — entity count, relationship count, type breakdowns

tools.name: memory_get_timeline
tools.description: Get the activity timeline for an entity — creation, updates, and relationship changes. Accepts entity ID (GUID) or slug.

conversationId.description: Filter to events from this conversation

actor.description: Filter to events by this actor

tools.name: memory_export_repository
tools.description: Export a memory repository to a .dkg (Deep Knowledge Graph) file on the local filesystem. The archive contains manifest.json, vocabulary.json, and chunked entities/relationships files. Returns the path — no data is sent to the AI.

repositoryId.description: UUID of the repository to export

legal.description: Optional legal/copyright metadata to embed in the archive manifest

license.description: SPDX license identifier or custom license name (e.g. "Apache-2.0", "LicenseRef-Proprietary")

licenseUrl.description: Full license text or URL pointing to license terms

terms.description: Human-readable usage terms or restrictions summary

contact.description: Contact for licensing questions (e.g. email address)

tools.name: memory_import_repository
tools.description: Import a .dkg (Deep Knowledge Graph) archive. Also accepts legacy .zip archives. Mode "create" creates a new repository and uses fast bulk inserts (no existence checks). Mode "merge" (default) imports into an existing repository — entities with matching IDs are overwritten; new vocabulary types are added automatically. Supports both multi-file (manifest.json + chunks) and legacy single-file archives.

repositoryId.description: UUID of the target repository to import into (merge) or for the new repository (create)

path.description: Absolute path to the .dkg or .zip archive to import

mode.description: Import mode: "create" for a new repository (fast, no existence checks), "merge" to import into an existing repository (default: merge)
